notes: The wiki: a caravan covers 13.6 tiles in 24 hours of travel on difficulty 1 (60,000 / 13.6 = 4,412 ticks a tile), moves from 6:00 to 22:00, a road halves a tile's movement difficulty whatever the road, hills add 0.5, 1.5 and 3, cold adds up to 2 from -17.1 down to -22.5 C, and a pawn carries 35 kg per body size. Speed from load is recalled from RimWorld's code (twice as fast empty, normal when full; the wiki is unsure). Our world is a grid, so a diagonal step costs the square root of 2. formHours: how long members may take to reach the map edge before the caravan leaves without them.
